pull_request.title: Infrastructure: confirm draft PR heads after publication
pull_request.head: codex/publisher-head-confirmation
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

The publisher can reject a valid draft immediately after pushing its final interaction-record commit. During task #124 recovery, draft PR #125 and its new head were published, an immediate generic verification failed, and subsequent PR/ref reads matched the local SHA. This change allows a short bounded head-confirmation retry while retaining the exact same completion checks.

## Change

- Read the expected local SHA once and allow five GitHub PR-head reads with 0.5/1/2/4-second backoff.
- Continue to reject a closed/ready PR or wrong source/target branch immediately. A persistently wrong SHA still fails; the diagnostic now includes both revisions and the PR URL.
- Add integration tests for a stale final head that converges and a permanently mismatched head that fails. Document the bounded confirmation behavior.

The old generic error did not retain its mismatched field, so short head propagation is a supported failure hypothesis rather than a reconstructed API response. This does not weaken exact SHA, draft-state or branch verification. No model, artifact or approval policy changes.

The tested publisher module is deployed locally pending this draft's review/merge. The stable runner was advanced to merged main, and task #124's prepared proposal is in draft PR #125. Configuration, task history and scheduler settings were preserved.

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Infrastructure only; no scientific tracking or sign-off changes.
- [x] 27 queue/publisher tests pass, including real local Git push and fake GitHub integration.
- [x] Persistent wrong heads still fail and do not produce a completed result.
- [x] Sessions/interactions validate and the token site builds; staged/new Git objects inspected.
- [x] No paid model call, native runtime or large data artifact used.

Session: `SESSION-2026-11-06-publisher-head-confirmation`. Exact task counters are unavailable; usage is unknown, not zero.

events.text:
The inactive stable checkout was still before the publisher merge. Recovery
advanced it to merged main while preserving configuration and queue history.
Publishing issue124 created [draft PR125](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/125)
and pushed its interaction record, but immediate final verification failed.
A subsequent PR and branch-ref API read both matched local revision
`c4b8107fae7d60d55ce28a5cdd51612934684323`. The original generic error did not
retain the mismatched response field, so a short head-propagation delay is the
supported hypothesis, not a reconstructed fact.

Head confirmation now allows five reads with 0.5/1/2/4-second backoff. The exact
published SHA must still match, and a wrong branch or closed/ready PR still fails
immediately. Persistent SHA mismatch fails after the bound and reports expected
and observed revisions. No acceptance requirement, title policy, artifact guard
or model sandbox is weakened. Updated the operations guide and deployed the
tested publisher module under the existing queue lock; retained rollback source.
